title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 6 market-aware football reasoning
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: The Top Picks detail view had verified offense, defense, pace, and history evidence, but the explanation layer did not interpret that evidence differently for Moneyline, Spread, and Over/Under.
root_cause: The frozen detail layer exposed generic model probability/reliability language and raw research blocks without a market-specific read-only synthesis contract.
patch: Add a new wrapper-only market reasoning engine, detail wrapper, V6 page, and active-route wrapper. Preserve frozen Steps 1-5 byte-for-byte and keep all reasoning at 0.0% projection weight.

exact_failures: app.py contained a literal \\n between the active router import and compatibility comment, causing SyntaxError
Step-6 certification was invoked as a file under devsystem/, so repository-root module cfb_top_picks_market_reasoning_v1 was not importable
control_plane_repair.root_cause: Two wiring mistakes in the initial Step-6 activation/proof path; the Step-6 market reasoning contract itself was already GREEN.
control_plane_repair.patch: Replace the literal newline escape with a real newline and invoke the cert with python -m devsystem.cfb_top_picks_research_v2_step6_market_reasoning_cert_v1.

dependency_light_lane_repair.root_cause: A pytest command was added to the intentionally dependency-light permanent-contract lane, which does not install pytest.
dependency_light_lane_repair.patch: Remove pytest from the dependency-light lane and compile the four Step-6 Python owners there instead. Deterministic Step-6 behavior remains certified by the existing dependency-free three-market cert.
